items.quote: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Israel prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
items.claim: The position of Moses's raised or lowered hand directly determines whether Israel or Amalek prevails in battle
items.action: held up and let down his hand
items.mechanism: Hand position causally determines military victory: raised hand → Israel prevails; lowered hand → Amalek prevails
